title: Grandparents with Grandchildren on Easter, 1959 B&W Vintage Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription:
Just thought you would enjoy this picture of the proud grandparents. This was taken at Easter 1959 and everyone was having fun. Joey made a bit of a face but that is just normal for his age, I guess.

Love
Barb

1999
description: A square snapshot with deckled edges capturing a multi-generational family outdoors on Easter Sunday in 1959. The proud grandparents stand in the background, both wearing mid-century eyeglasses. In front, a young boy named Joey smiles with a playful expression while holding a small toy bunny, dressed in suspenders and a collared shirt. Beside him, a little girl wears a puffed-sleeve crinoline dress and holds a stuffed rabbit. Sunlight casts sharp shadows against the light exterior wall behind them.
